Re: 

Briefing Schedule in No.  17-290, Merck Sharp & Dahme Corp.  v.  Albrecht,  et al. 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

I represent Petitioner in  Merck Sharp & Dahme Corp.  v.  Albrecht,  et al., granted on June 
28,  2018.  I am writing to respectfully request that the Court adopt a briefing schedule that makes 
Petitioner's opening brief due September 13, Respondents'  brief due November 14, and 
Petitioner's reply due December 14.  David Frederick, counsel for Respondents, has agreed to 
this proposed schedule, which accommodates both his commitments and mine, and which will 
allow the case to be fully briefed before the Court's January sitting. 

Without any change to the briefing schedule, Petitioner's brief would be due August  13, 
Respondents'  would be due September 12, and Petitioner's reply would be due on October 12. 

Sincerely, 

Shay Dvoretzky
